apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: Rest start is now a crisp double-click followed by stillness, so it can't be mistaken for lowering.
Vibration strength: Off / Subtle / Normal / Strong. Push now feels gritty and builds; lowering is smooth and sinks.
Ring stays steady through relax, rests and setup: rep notches stay put, only the center circle breathes.
